report.summary: Plan to fix 9 reviewed findings: patch _human_bytes, implement _spec_for, document meta cap, fix docstring, improve egress, fix comment stripper, add lock, fix breadcrumb, remove undefined CLI refs.
risks: Fixing _human_bytes may break callers expecting bytes output.
Implementing _spec_for may require understanding of subclass usage.
Adding lock to index.py may introduce contention.
Removing CLI references may confuse users if they rely on documented options.
todos: Ensure tests cover edge cases for each fix.
Coordinate with team on API changes.

items.title: Fix _human_bytes bug to return correct units
items.why_now: Confirmed bug that always returns bytes; affects user-facing output.

steps.do: Correct the loop logic in _human_bytes to divide n by 1024 before the next iteration and use the appropriate unit.

items.assumption: The function is in some_file.py; adjust if different.

items.title: Implement _spec_for method to avoid AttributeError
items.why_now: Confirmed stub that may be called; high severity.

steps.do: Implement _spec_for with appropriate logic or raise NotImplementedError if abstract.
steps.verified_by: Run tests that call _spec_for; no AttributeError.

items.assumption: The method's intended behavior can be inferred from call sites.

steps.do: Update docstring to state that ValueError is raised for invalid inputs.

items.title: Add length cap to Attempt.meta field
items.why_now: Narrowed finding: latent unbounded growth risk.

steps.do: Add validation in record_attempt to enforce a maximum meta size (e.g., 10KB).
steps.verified_by: Unit test: passing meta > limit raises error.

items.assumption: A reasonable cap can be determined.

items.title: Improve egress completeness in classify_data paths
items.why_now: Narrowed to high severity if paths are incomplete.

steps.do: Audit paths passed to classify_data and ensure all accessed files are included; add test files and dependencies.
steps.verified_by: Trace file access with strace and compare to paths list.

items.assumption: The egress gate is in classify_data and paths are passed from codex_cli.py.

items.title: Fix _strip_comments_generic to handle escaped quotes
items.why_now: Narrowed edge case that could cause false clone detections.

steps.do: Update regex to handle escaped backslashes before quotes.

items.title: Add lock to resolver cache writes in index.py
items.why_now: Needs-evidence finding; adding lock prevents potential inconsistency.

steps.do: Add threading lock around cache writes for same scope_key.
steps.verified_by: Test concurrent builds; no cache drift.

items.title: Fix withheld breadcrumb to record all roles

steps.do: Update breadcrumb logic to append or overwrite with all roles.
steps.verified_by: Test: withhold file under two roles; breadcrumb shows both.

items.title: Remove undefined Ikarus and watcher references from CLI help

steps.do: Update help strings in orchestrate.py to remove references to Ikarus and watcher.
steps.verified_by: Grep for Ikarus and watcher; no false positives.

items.assumption: No external documentation relies on these references.
